pick.headline: Ceausescu flees Bucharest as the Romanian revolution triumphs
pick.summary: On December 22, 1989, Nicolae and Elena Ceausescu fled the Central Committee building in Bucharest by helicopter as the army went over to the crowds. Fighting with Securitate loyalists continued for days.
pick.significance: Romania's was the only violent overthrow of a communist regime in Eastern Europe in 1989.
